scope: Local release CDS processes, software attestation, TLS storage fixtures and a separate unreplicated SQLite metadata process. No cloud resources or production rollout.
interpretation: Small-policy/current-state data stays encrypted in metadata; large values still require immutable object storage.
Earlier object-backed policy variants failed bounded load requests; these failures are retained, not omitted.
A clean matched comparison and three extra hot-policy repetitions passed; performance is local one-host evidence, not a production SLO.
Revocation acknowledgement was slower for direct state than the WAL control in the matched run, despite faster cold process recovery.
No per-replica Raft, application WAL, replay, checkpoint or preferred-writer protocol runs in the direct backend. Provider consensus, independent custody and metadata HA remain required.
